Default interface: ncurses. /set default_interface idle|ncurses chooses the next fresh launch; /save input saves the choice in the main config.
Explicit -i/--idle or -N/--ncurses overrides that launch without saving the override. Lowercase -n still selects the nickname.
The shared config parser preserves either recognized saved value. A stored ncurses value does not change this standalone client's interface.
In full ncurses, App -> Key bindings or /bindings opens an editable table with Apply, Save and Escape/Cancel; -i uses the commands.
This client edits bindings through commands; /bindings lists the current table.
Minimalist mode uses the usual application configuration and saved server catalog.
[interface] history_lines= sets the retained-chat limit; other interface preferences remain saved.
If the new default is absent, an existing 1keyirc/config.ini under the same configuration base is used in place.
Existing settings, server catalogs and credential paths are not moved. The onekeyirc default wins when both exist.
An unsafe or unreadable default is reported instead of silently choosing another file. --config FILE overrides this selection.
[history] lines= sets the retained-chat limit. Configuration does not contain [interface] options.

onekeyirc - command-oriented terminal IRC
Default config file: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/onekeyirc/config.ini; XDG_CONFIG_HOME must be absolute.
When XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset or empty: $HOME/.config/onekeyirc/config.ini. --config FILE selects another file.
From the shell: onekeyirc --sessions; onekeyirc --detach-session NUMBER; onekeyirc --resume NUMBER; onekeyirc --close-session NUMBER.
The default application history limit is 100 records.
onekeyirc --manual prints this complete manual.
onekeyirc always uses idle. Its application panel omits interface selection; /set default_interface accepts only idle.
vipirc - command-oriented terminal IRC
Default config file: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vipirc/config.ini; XDG_CONFIG_HOME must be absolute.
When XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset or empty: $HOME/.config/vipirc/config.ini. --config FILE selects another file.
From the shell: vipirc --sessions; vipirc --detach-session NUMBER; vipirc --resume NUMBER; vipirc --close-session NUMBER.
The default application history limit is 500 records.
vipirc -i --manual prints this complete manual.

Bare vipirc --resume retains the worker's current interface. vipirc -i --resume NUMBER selects minimalist; vipirc -N --resume NUMBER selects ncurses. Changing interfaces keeps IRC/history/transfers but discards drafts, pending send reviews, command recall and unapplied forms.
